keepRunningHint: Shows a permanent notification so other devices can reach this device at any time.
httpsUnavailable: encryption needs Android 5.0 or newer. This device uses unencrypted HTTP: you can receive from everyone, but to send from this device the receiver must turn off "Encryption".
resetIdentityHint: A new certificate and fingerprint are created. Other devices will see this device as a new one; favorites on other devices must be added again.
longPressToRename: long-press a file to rename it
webReceiveHint: devices without LocalSend can upload files to this device by opening the link in their browser.
aboutFork: OldySend is a fork of LocalSend that runs on every Android version since 1.0 and speaks the same protocol, so it can exchange files with LocalSend on any platform.
licensesText: OldySend and LocalSend: Apache License 2.0. Android framework artwork (2.3.7, 4.4.4), Droid Sans and Roboto fonts: Android Open Source Project, Apache License 2.0. Material Icons and Material Symbols: Google, Apache License 2.0.
oldAndroidSymptom: This device runs Android 1.x–4.4 and cannot send files to some devices.
oldAndroidSolution: Old Android versions cannot use LocalSend's encryption (TLS 1.2 with AES-GCM). They receive over plain HTTP from anyone, but to send to a device, turn off "Encryption" in that device's LocalSend settings. Discovery on Android 1.0–1.5 may need the "Search devices" button, because multicast is often blocked there.
iconFollowsStyle: App icon matches the interface style
iconFollowsStyleHint: Some launchers remove the home screen shortcut when the icon changes.
connectFailed: Could not connect to {address}. Check that both devices are in the same network and that the app is open on the other device.
